description: Synchronous buck VIN=5 D=0.4 fsw=1MHz L=10u C=22u R=2.5. Cycle-aligned window after settling (tau=2RC=110us). Mean VO reflects ideal D*VIN minus declared dead-time diode and ron losses; VSW must stay rail-bounded; inductor ripple must match the analytic value.
dut: X1 ctl 0 vin sw 0 bhv_sw_bbm_pair_v1 tdead=10n

relations.derivation: D*VIN=2.0 minus: exact-ron conduction drop (Iload~0.754A x 50mOhm), dead-time diode conduction on BOTH edges, delayed high-side turn-on (tdead=10ns shortens the effective on interval, ~50mV at these values), and 4x2ns edge-interpolation intervals. Earlier drafts read ~1.925 because aswitch thresholds inside the drive range extrapolated ron ~1260x low; cntl thresholds now equal the drive rails so ron is exact. Measured 1.886 on ngspice 45.2.
VSW never exceeds VIN beyond the smooth-switch residue; the 2*VIN commutation-spike class is structurally absent.
one declared freewheel diode drop below ground during dead time.
(VIN-VO)*D/(L*fsw) with the measured VO=1.886: 3.114*0.4e-6/10e-6 = 0.1246 A analytic; measured 0.1210 (2.9% below, duty shortened by dead time and edge intervals). rtol 5% covers the correction.
